svg.title: Orchestration agent and model access
svg.text: Every team gets one orchestration agent at creation. Only it can be reached from outside the cluster, and every model call must pass three narrowing lists.

g.text: created with the team; default-deny network
service ∩ team ∩ agent (∩ pool), and the model must have an approved price; fails closed
collaboration tool: Paperclip AI (default) or Buzz
Web UI and Web API: Off · Private · Public
Buzz: both surfaces N/A (no browser client or REST API)
